title: Implement confirmatory freeze manifest admission
description: Production prerequisite for task-3a34adcabd03489e84f8dfbec913633a, ordered after task-22b69ee54fa740028d991127974b8410. Build the @moe/benchmark mechanism that admits independently signed Phase-0/corpus/configuration manifests and mechanically binds one campaign to one implementation SHA. It must not author, view, embed, score, or publish confirmatory corpus bytes. Consumer: task-3a34adcabd03489e84f8dfbec913633a, then task-8af4562ff1ae41b28876aaee63f05ea3.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK FIRST: at the delivered tree prove task-22b69ee54fa740028d991127974b8410's human-approved authority is present through its public production strict reader and includes a real custodian, key ID/public key, signature algorithm, canonical-byte rule, registry semantics, and implementation-SHA derivation with no placeholder/unsigned fallback. If any symbol/value/callable reader is absent or ambiguous, report blocked; relaxing this gate would let developer- or caller-owned bytes certify the corpus.

A canonical exact-version freeze manifest binds one campaign ID to the independently derived clean implementation SHA, design SHA-256, benchmark SHA-256, frozen constants, gate inventory, comparator/model-match matrix, hardware/runtime identity, corpus/configuration/analysis/prompts/scripts/cohort digest commitments, signer key ID, seal timestamp, and public registry reference; strict decode rejects missing and extra fields.

Production admission independently reads the clean checkout SHA at one stable horizon, canonicalizes and hashes the manifest, verifies its detached signature through the approved authority, cross-checks every identity/digest, and returns a freshly rebuilt deeply frozen value without exposing or reading restricted corpus contents.

Any missing, malformed, stale, foreign, conflicting, dirty-tree, invalid-signature, untrusted-key, registry-mismatch, horizon-moved, or implementation-SHA mismatch refuses closed with a stable admission code/layer plus exact source code/layer. A changed SHA can only request a new freeze; it can never mutate or extend the prior campaign.

TDD covers every field and wrapper/source attribution through production readers, asserts exact code/layer, positive nonzero case counts, close/reopen where file-backed state is used, and mutation drills for SHA, signature, exact-key roster, and source-attribution assertions. No corpus bytes or signing private key enter fixtures or commits.

Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark test` exit 0 with nonzero Test Files/Tests counts. Record counts, mutation outcomes, exact owned paths, and consumer task IDs in durable comments; explicit-pathspec commit only.

Caller-supplied SHA, digest, key, signature policy, registry state, or corpus metadata never becomes authority.
Do not create, view, store, log, or commit confirmatory corpus contents or private signing material.
Keep claim scoring and comparative campaign execution out of scope; use TDD, exact code/layer assertions, and focused files under the per-file cap.
